why: This is a study-specific mathematics assessment instrument consisting of four versions of six two-step word problems, not a reusable instructional element.
name: Four-test instrument (T0–T3) of six two-step word problems with Knifong and Holtan error scoring
product_description: A paper-and-pencil assessment developed by Haghverdi and colleagues to measure seventh-grade students’ two-step arithmetic word-problem solving and error types across original, contextual, conceptual, and combined-rewording versions.
